title: Starbub
author: Dramatic-Shape5574
selftext:
This is a personal project that I'm probably not going to publish, but the challenge I made to myself was basically to create a Star Fox clone based on my dog and generally achieve a convincing SuperFX aesthetic. I spent about 4 hours on this in total just to give you context on the scope and the (surprisingly little) amount of fucking around I had to do with Codex. I'm kind of figuring out my workflows still -- I have a skill/script to scale down AI-generated pixel art, but otherwise this was pure back and forth Codex. A lot of the assets had to be created outside of Codex. It's currently a single level, but if I end up completing this, I'll follow back up with the results.

Here's my stack:

Music: Suno

Title Screen Art: gpt-image-2

Sound Effects: Eleven Labs

Enemy/ship geometry: Gemini 3.1 Pro

Coding: GPT-5.5 high via codex
